title: Death Stranding 2: On the Beach joins the PlayStation Plus Game Catalogue (Extra and Deluxe tiers; not Essential) on 17 Nov 2026, per Sony's November catalogue post on the PlayStation Blog (10 Nov), with Atomfall and Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake the same day; Sony says lineups may differ by region. PlayStation India prices: Extra ₹979/month, Deluxe ₹1,109, Essential ₹649; DS2 Standard Edition ₹4,999 list on PS Store India
